image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a disposable plastic lighter. The top section features a brushed metal windguard with the brand name 'Atomic' embossed on it. Below the metal guard is a black plastic collar and a translucent blue plastic fuel reservoir. A black ignition wheel is visible on the right side. The background is a blurred, textured surface, likely fabric or wood.
